meta.name: airunway-aks-setup
meta.description: Set up AI Runway on AKS — from bare cluster to running model. Covers cluster verification, controller install, GPU assessment, provider setup, and first deployment. WHEN: "setup AI Runway", "onboard AKS cluster", "install AI Runway", "airunway setup", "deploy model to AKS", "GPU inference on AKS", "KAITO setup on AKS", "run LLM on AKS", "vLLM on AKS", "set up model serving on AKS", "AI Runway controller".

copy.tagline: 将AI Runway快速部署到Azure Kubernetes集群
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在Azure上搭建AI推理环境
copy.tagline_en: Deploy AI Runway onto an AKS cluster in minutes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to set up AI inference on Azure

howto.what: Claude 会按顺序带你走 AKS 上的 AI Runway 六个步骤:验证集群、安装控制器、评估 GPU、配置推理 provider、部署第一个模型、总结收尾。每步会报告集群状态,并在安装或部署前先征求你同意。
howto.when: 当你提到 “setup AI Runway”、“install AI Runway” 等关键词,或想在已有的 AKS 集群上从零搭建 AI Runway 时触发。前提是集群已经存在。

howto.what_en: Claude runs six ordered steps on AKS: verify the cluster, install the controller, assess GPUs, set up an inference provider, deploy a first model, then recap. It reports cluster state each step and asks before installing or deploying.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "setup AI Runway", "install AI Runway" or similar, or want to onboard an existing AKS cluster to AI Runway from scratch. A cluster must already exist.
